title: dryas octopetala subsp. viscosa
intro: Dryas octopetala subsp. viscosa, commonly known as Sticky Mountain Avens, is a plant species in the rose family that grows in mountainous regions. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce pain and inflammation, and protect against cell damage. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiviral properties, which can aid in the treatment of various infections and conditions. The bioactive constituents of Dryas octopetala subsp. viscosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
